info.name: Paga Developer Business API
info.description:
Paga (Pagatech Financial Services Limited) is a Nigerian mobile-money and payments company licensed by the Central Bank of Nigeria. This document models three REST product surfaces: the Business API (disbursements, airtime/data, merchant payments, bank deposits, customer onboarding), the Collect API (NGN collections via payment requests and persistent payment account numbers), and the Direct Debit API (bank-account mandate tokenization and recurring charges). All amounts are in Nigerian Naira (NGN). Every request carries a SHA-512 `hash` header computed over an operation-specific ordered concatenation of parameters plus the account hash key.

Contact Support:
 Name: Paga Developer Support
 Email: businesssupport@paga.com

request.description: Transfers money from the business Paga account to a recipient phone number or bank account. hash = SHA-512(referenceNumber + amount + destinationAccount + destinationBank + hashKey).
